_comment: Shared base. Every package extends this or one of its siblings.
Moved here from the repo-root tsconfig.base.json on 2026-09-02 so that
compiler settings travel as a workspace dependency like everything else,
rather than as a relative path each package has to get right. The root
tsconfig.base.json is kept as a one-line re-export so nothing breaks
Deliberately NOT enabled yet: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters,
noImplicitReturns. Multica runs all three and they are good rules, but
turning them on here would produce a large, unrelated cleanup diff across
60K LOC in the middle of a restructure. Enable them as their own change
